about.title: About Us
about.metaDescription: Learn about our story, mission, and commitment to bringing you the finest bags and accessories. Discover what makes us different and why quality matters to us.
about.heroSubtitle: Discover the story behind our passion for bringing you the finest bags and accessories
about.ourStoryParagraph1: Founded with a passion for quality and style, our store has been dedicated to bringing you the finest selection of bags and accessories. What started as a small dream has grown into a trusted destination for fashion-conscious individuals who appreciate craftsmanship and attention to detail.
about.ourStoryParagraph2: We believe that the right bag or accessory can transform not just your outfit, but your entire day. That's why we carefully curate each piece in our collection, ensuring that every item meets our high standards for quality, durability, and style.
about.ourMissionParagraph1: Our mission is simple: to provide our customers with exceptional products that combine functionality with fashion. We're committed to offering a diverse range of bags and accessories that cater to different lifestyles, preferences, and budgets.
about.ourMissionParagraph2: We strive to create a shopping experience that's not just about purchasing products, but about discovering pieces that truly resonate with your personal style and enhance your daily life.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.metaDescription: Frequently asked questions about our store, shipping, returns, and customer service.
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our store and services.

ordering.title: Ordering & Payment
ordering.q1: How do I place an order?
ordering.a1: Browse our products, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You'll need to create an account or log in to complete your purchase.
ordering.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
ordering.a2: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and other secure payment methods through our payment processor.
ordering.a3: Yes, all payment information is encrypted and processed through secure payment gateways. We never store your payment details on our servers.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.a1: Standard shipping typically takes 3-7 business days. Express shipping options are available at checkout for faster delivery.
shipping.a2: Yes, we ship to most countries worldwide. Shipping costs and delivery times vary by location.
shipping.q3: How can I track my order?
shipping.a3: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can also check your order status in your account dashboard.

returns.title: Returns & Exchanges
returns.a1: We offer a 30-day return policy for most items. Products must be in original condition with tags attached.
returns.q2: How do I return an item?
returns.a2: Contact our customer service team to initiate a return. We'll provide you with a return label and instructions.
returns.q3: When will I receive my refund?
returns.a3: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive your returned item.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information in our privacy policy.
privacy.intro: We are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our service.

collect.heading: 1. Information We Collect
collect.personalIntro: We may collect personal information that you provide directly to us, such as:
personal: Name and contact information (email, phone, address)
Payment information (processed securely through third-party providers)
collect.autoIntro: When you visit our website, we may automatically collect:
auto: Pages visited and time spent on site

use.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
use.intro: We use the information we collect for various purposes, including:
items: Processing and fulfilling your orders
Providing customer support and responding to inquiries
Improving our website and services
Sending promotional emails and marketing communications (with your consent)
Preventing fraud and ensuring security
Complying with legal obligations

sharing.heading: 3. Information Sharing
sharing.intro: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information in the following circumstances:
items: With service providers who help us operate our business (payment processors, shipping companies)
When required by law or to protect our rights
In connection with a business transfer or merger
With your explicit consent

security.heading: 4. Data Security
security.intro: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include:
items: SSL encryption for data transmission
Secure servers and databases
Regular security audits and updates
Limited access to personal information by authorized personnel only

cookies.heading: 5. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.intro: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience. Cookies help us:
items: Remember your preferences and login information
Analyze website traffic and usage patterns
Provide personalized content and recommendations
Improve our website functionality
cookies.outro: You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences, but disabling cookies may affect website functionality.

rights.heading: 6. Your Rights
rights.intro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:
items: Access: Request a copy of the personal information we hold about you
Correction: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
Deletion: Request deletion of your personal information
Portability: Request transfer of your data to another service
Opt-out: Unsubscribe from marketing communications

thirdParty.heading: 7. Third-Party Links
thirdParty.body: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these external sites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party sites you visit.

children.heading: 8. Children's Privacy
children.body: Our services are not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that we have collected such information, we will take steps to delete it promptly.

international.heading: 9. International Data Transfers
international.body: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own. We ensure that such transfers comply with applicable data protection laws and implement appropriate safeguards.

changes.heading: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.

contact.heading: 11. Contact Us
contact.pre: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please

terms.metaDescription: Read our terms and conditions for using our ecommerce store and services.
terms.intro: Please read these Terms and Conditions carefully before using our service. By accessing or using our service, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

acceptance.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing and using this website, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement. If you do not agree to abide by the above, please do not use this service.

license.heading: 2. Use License
license.intro: Permission is granted to temporarily download one copy of the materials on our website for personal, non-commercial transitory viewing only. This is the grant of a license, not a transfer of title, and under this license you may not:
items: modify or copy the materials
use the materials for any commercial purpose or for any public display
attempt to reverse engineer any software contained on the website

productInfo.heading: 3. Product Information
productInfo.body: We strive to provide accurate product information, including descriptions, pricing, and availability. However, we do not warrant that product descriptions or other content is accurate, complete, reliable, current, or error-free.

pricing.heading: 4. Pricing and Payment
pricing.body: All prices are subject to change without notice. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue products at any time. Payment must be received before products are shipped. We accept various payment methods as displayed during checkout.

shipping.heading: 5. Shipping and Delivery
shipping.body: We will make every effort to ship products within the timeframe specified. However, delivery dates are estimates and we are not responsible for delays caused by shipping carriers or other circumstances beyond our control.

returns.heading: 6. Returns and Refunds
returns.body: We offer a 30-day return policy for most items. Products must be returned in original condition with all packaging and tags. Refunds will be processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days of receiving the returned item.

userAccounts.heading: 7. User Accounts
userAccounts.body: When you create an account, you must provide accurate and complete information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account.
